parent_row_sharing.format: Numeric record may replace numerator/denominator with parent_rows; each entry is [numeratorRow,denominatorRow] or {reference:{record,row}}, same-file by default.
parent_row_sharing.preserves: Parent ordering, every floating-point value, HOTA and all method keys are unchanged.
parent_row_sharing.resolver: scripts/a100_visual_classical_sparse_statistics_reproduce.py resolves both legacy whole-record and new parent-row references.
parent_row_sharing.selection: Only used when serialized file is smaller; no rounding, pruning, metric or bootstrap changes.

aggregate_encoding.meaning: Lossless zlib+base64 encoding of the exact compact-JSON parent_rows field. No numeric rounding; same references and all methods retained.
aggregate_encoding.scope: Aggregated official sufficient counts only, not checkpoints/raw features/QA. HOTA and parent names remain directly readable.
aggregate_encoding.validation: aggregate_encoding_regression.json plus full NumPy HOTA/effect reproduction for each study

shared_aggregate_archive.meaning: One numeric record owns zlib+base64 of compactJSON {recordName:parent_rows}. Every numeric method keeps HOTA/parents readable; record list unchanged. Old plain/per-row/per-record formats still supported.
shared_aggregate_archive.decoder: expand_statistic_archive in sparse_statistics_reproduce.py; standard-library JSON/zlib/base64 only
shared_aggregate_archive.validation: aggregate_shared_archive_regression.json and complete NumPy effect reproduction; no numeric rounding or experiment removal

aggregate_float64_row_codec.meaning: ExactIEEE754little-endianfloat64 count rowpair, byte-shuffled reversibly; no numeric quantization. References/HOTA/parents stay readable.
